title: 第8章 多管闲事？老子这叫执行正义！
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

小仙女本想趁着苏子文没反应过来，一走了之。

当下被人喊住——走也不是，不走也不是。

紧接着，她就发现了“鹤立鸡群”的江辰。

因为就在刚刚江辰说完话后，他就成了人群目光的焦点。

扫了一眼江辰的穿着打扮，小仙女顿时满眼轻蔑地道：

“你他妈的是哪根葱？这里有你什么事？”

江辰嘴角勾起一抹人畜无害的笑，道：

“我不过是陈述事实，你怎么就急眼了？还是说，心虚了？”

“我……我心虚什么？”小仙女立即出声反驳。

一只手，下意识死死按住腰间的LV包包。

“分手是你提的，那么这哥们以男朋友的名义，赠送给你的东西，你是不是该还回来？”

江辰这话一落，宛若一石，激起千层浪！

“难怪，她刚刚走得那么急，原来是怕男方把送她名牌包包给要回来。”

“这女的，一副自持金贵的样子，没想到骨子里却跟个要饭似的。”

“可不嘛，分手了，还想占男方的便宜，真他妈的不要脸！”

“你，你们......”

面对周遭的议论，小仙女恨得直咬牙，面色更是气得一片涨红。

她狠狠瞪了江辰一眼，怒声道：“谁让你多管闲事的，你这人是不是嘴贱啊？”

本来嘛，江辰是不想多管闲事的。

毕竟这种舔狗和绿茶的撕逼名场面，在他的小说里，没有一百，也有八十了。

可就在刚刚。

他脑海中响起了“叮”的一道机械声。

系统又给他发布任务了。

【专属打脸任务：请宿主帮助系统认证群体‘舔狗’苏子文，完成打脸绿茶女‘李嫣然’，可获得2万元专属奖励！”

江辰毫不犹豫就接下了这个专属打脸任务。

毕竟，谁会跟钱过不去？

“说了，我方才只是陈述事实。”

江辰嘴角泛起一抹冷笑，“怎么，既然都分手了，你该不会想耍赖，不想归还男方送的东西了吧？”

“你......”

李嫣然嘴角直抽搐，肺险些都要气炸了。

与此同时，江辰脑海中传来了系统的提示声。

【当前打脸进度50%，请宿主继续对绿茶女重拳出击！】

江辰心想道：哎，看来还得加把劲！

“愣着干嘛？赶紧把包包还给人家啊！难不成，你是真不打算要逼脸了？”江辰戏谑地看着李嫣然。

话落，围观的群众立刻有不少人声援。

“就是就是，分手就把包还给男方，最基本的道理都不懂吗？”

“这女的心里一点B数没有，妈的，真想拿拖鞋上去扇她几十个来回！”

“……”

李嫣然就快被周围的口水淹没掉，恨不能找条地缝钻进去。

看到这一幕，苏子文都愣住了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The little fairy wanted to leave before Su Ziwen could react.

If someone calls me to stop right now - it doesn't matter if I leave, it doesn't matter if I don't leave.

Immediately afterwards, she discovered Jiang Chen, who "stands out from the crowd".

Because just after Jiang Chen finished speaking, he became the focus of the crowd's attention.

After glancing at Jiang Chen's clothes, the little fairy suddenly said with disdain in her eyes:

"Who the hell are you? What business do you have here?"

The corners of Jiang Chen's lips curled up into a harmless smile, and he said:

"I'm just stating the facts, why are you so impatient? Or are you feeling guilty?"

"I...what am I guilty of?" the little fairy immediately retorted.

One hand subconsciously held the LV bag on his waist.

"You initiated the breakup, so should you return the things this guy gave you in the name of your boyfriend?"

As soon as Jiang Chen said these words, it was like a stone that stirred up a thousand waves!

"No wonder she left in such a hurry just now. It turned out that she was afraid that the man would take back the designer bag he gave her."

"This woman looks like she is precious, but she is like a beggar at heart."

"No, after breaking up, you still want to take advantage of the man. How fucking shameless!"

"You, you..."

Facing the comments around her, the little fairy gritted her teeth with hatred, and her face turned red with anger.

She glared at Jiang Chen fiercely and said angrily: "Who told you to meddle in other people's business? Are you a mean-mouthed person?"

Originally, Jiang Chen didn't want to meddle in other people's business.

After all, this famous scene of dog licking and green tea has been recorded in his novels for as many as eighty if not a hundred.

But just now.

A mechanical sound of "ding" sounded in his mind.

The system issued another task to him.

[Exclusive face-slapping task: Ask the host to help the system authenticate the group "dog licker" Su Ziwen, complete the face-slapping of the green tea girl "Li Yanran", and you will receive an exclusive reward of 20,000 yuan!"

Jiang Chen accepted this exclusive face-slapping task without hesitation.

After all, who has trouble with money?

"As I said, I was just stating the facts."

A sneer appeared at the corner of Jiang Chen's mouth, "Why, since we broke up, you don't want to cheat and return the things the man gave you, right?"

"You..."

The corners of Li Yanran's mouth twitched, and her lungs almost exploded with anger.

At the same time, a system prompt sounded in Jiang Chen's mind.

[The current slap in the face progress is 50%, please host continue to hit the green tea girl hard!】

Jiang Chen thought to himself: Hey, it looks like we have to work harder!

"Why are you standing there?Hurry and return the bag to others!Is it possible that you really don’t want to show off?"Jiang Chen looked at Li Yanran jokingly.

As soon as he finished speaking, many people in the crowd immediately expressed their support.

"That's right, just return the bag to the man after breaking up. Don't you understand the most basic principles?"

"This woman has no clue at all. Damn it, I really want to slap her with my slippers dozens of times!"

"..."

Li Yanran was almost drowned by the saliva around her, wishing she could find a crack in the ground to crawl in.

Seeing this scene, Su Ziwen was stunned.
